# Lumilio Agent run with a confirmed effect

_sequence · source: `docs/atlas/views/sequence/agent-effect.yaml`_

How the in-app assistant changes the library safely. The model only ever sees references to asset sets, never asset data. A mutating tool prepares a pending effect and interrupts the run; nothing changes until the user approves, and the mutation and its receipt then commit in one catalog transaction.

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor n_user as User
    participant n_web as Lumilio chat (Web)
    participant n_handler as AgentHandler
    participant n_service as AgentService
    participant n_llm as LLM provider
    participant n_tools as Tools (producers, effects)
    participant n_refs as Reference store
    participant n_effects as EffectRuntime
    n_user->>n_web: #quot;Put my best beach photos from 2024 in an album#quot;
    n_web->>n_handler: POST /agent/chat (SSE)
    n_handler->>n_service: AskAgent(thread, mode)
    n_service->>n_llm: run with the mode's tool set, checkpointed per thread
    loop tool calls
        n_llm->>n_tools: call a producer (filter, lookup, combine, quality filter…)
        n_tools->>n_refs: resolve against the authorized library, store an asset-set reference
        n_tools-->>n_llm: receipt {ref id, count} — never asset data
        n_tools-)n_web: side-channel events (progress, widget data)
    end
    n_llm->>n_tools: call an effect (add_to_album)
    n_tools->>n_effects: Prepare pending effect (membership snapshot)
    n_tools-->>n_web: interrupt — confirmation card with count and target
    n_user->>n_web: approve (or decline)
    n_web->>n_handler: POST /agent/chat/resume
    n_handler->>n_service: ResumeAgent from the checkpoint
    alt approved
        n_tools->>n_effects: Commit — mutation + receipt in one transaction
    else declined
        n_tools->>n_effects: Reject
    end
    n_tools-->>n_web: effect receipt
```

## Invariants

Tools return receipts or typed recoverable errors, never asset rows. Effects are bounded by the membership captured at Prepare, so the library changing between the question and the approval cannot widen what is mutated. A run can be cancelled and an effect receipt reconciled even when inference is unavailable.
